about.title: Let's work together
about.text1: Write some information about yourself that is IT related. Why are you passionate about programming? What is your source of inspiration for improving your coding skills? Show a desire to learn new technologies.
about.text2: Describe your approach to problem solving. Do you learn from each challenge to find the most efficient or elegant solution? You can include some key attributes such as: analytical thinking, creativity, persistence and collaboration.

projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.polloLoco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.daBubble: A very Simple Customer Relationship Management system working with CRUD functionality.
projects.pokedex: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

privacy.hosting: This website is hosted by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. Every time you visit the website, the server automatically records technical data that your browser transmits: IP address, date and time of the request, the page requested, browser type and version, operating system and the previously visited page. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; my legitimate interest is the secure and error-free operation of the website. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.contact: If you send me a message via the contact form, I process your name, your email address and your message in order to answer your request. The data is transmitted to me via the servers of Cloudflare and is only used for this purpose. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, which you give by ticking the checkbox. You can withdraw it at any time with effect for the future. I delete your data as soon as your request has been dealt with, unless statutory retention periods apply.
privacy.fonts: All fonts are stored on this server and loaded from there. No connection to Google or other font providers is established.
privacy.cookies: This website does not use cookies, analytics tools or tracking.
privacy.links: This website contains links to GitHub and LinkedIn as well as to my projects. Data is only transmitted to these services once you click on a link. From then on, the privacy policy of the respective provider applies.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR), to rectification (Art. 16), to erasure (Art. 17), to restriction of processing (Art. 18), to data portability (Art. 20) and to object to processing (Art. 21). To exercise these rights, simply write to me at contact@keanucentamore.de. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information North Rhine-Westphalia.
privacy.encryption: For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise an encrypted connection by the lock symbol and “https://” in the address bar of your browser.
